name: Banako
source:
Vice President

A St. Bernard that is basically the mascot of Eureka Software.
Banako is [url=/c79484]Honoka's[/url] dog, but she often leaves her behind when heading out of the office, so [url=/c79479]Ai[/url] is mainly in charge of walks.
She has an energy drink for [url=/c79481]Saki[/url] hanging from her neck, but as of yet it hasn't been drunk.

[From [url=http://yuremaster.kogado.com/en/character/]Official site[/url]]
